actions.label: Resolve party
actions.description: Find or create the friend record for an external identity.
actions.agent: Resolve an external identity (provider + externalId on a channel) into a friend record, creating one on first contact. Returns { friend, channel, created }.

provider.label: Provider
provider.description: identity provider, e.g. aad, local, teams-conversation, imessage-handle, email-address, a2a-agent

externalId.label: External id
externalId.description: the external identity within the provider

displayName.label: Display name
displayName.description: display name for the party (use 'Unknown' if not known)

channel.label: Channel
channel.description: the channel/sense the session belongs to, e.g. cli, teams, mcp

actions.label: Describe trust
actions.description: Explain how much a friend is trusted and why.
actions.agent: Explain the trust context for a friend: level, basis (direct/shared_group/unknown), what it permits and constrains.

isGroupChat.label: Group chat
isGroupChat.description: set to 'true' when the conversation is a group chat

actions.label: Assess standing
actions.description: Judge a peer's standing from your own past outcomes with them.
actions.agent: Assess a peer's earned standing from your FIRST-PARTY outcomes with them: a tier (proven/reliable/mixed/untested/troubled), the basis count, and the tally. Advisory only — never changes trust, never shared. Returns a Standing, or { ok:false, status:'not_found' } when the friend is missing.

actions.label: Explain standing
actions.description: Explain a peer's standing in words, as input to a manual trust decision.
actions.agent: Explain a peer's earned standing in words: the tier with a human summary, why, and advisory notes that frame it as input to a MANUAL trust decision (never an instruction to change trust). Returns a StandingExplanation, or { ok:false, status:'not_found' } when the friend is missing.

actions.label: Get friend
actions.description: Look up one friend record.
actions.agent: Fetch a single friend record by uuid or by name.

actions.label: List friends
actions.description: List the friend records, optionally filtered.
actions.agent: List friend records, optionally filtered by trust level and kind, optionally limited.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: max number of records to return

actions.label: Save note
actions.description: Save a friend's name, a tool preference or a note.
actions.agent: Save a friend's name, a tool preference, or a general note. Use override='true' to overwrite an existing value.

override.label: Override
override.description: set to 'true' to overwrite an existing value

actions.label: Record interaction
actions.description: Record a turn with a friend: token usage and any shared-mission outcome.
actions.agent: Record a turn with a friend: accumulate token usage and/or append a shared-mission outcome (bumping familiarity).

usage.label: Usage
usage.description: token usage; only output_tokens is counted

actions.label: Upsert group
actions.description: Link a group's participants to it and remember them.
actions.agent: Upsert shared-group participant context: link each participant to the group, promoting strangers to acquaintances.

actions.label: Set trust
actions.description: Set how much a friend is trusted.
actions.agent: Set a friend's trust level (also mirrors it onto the record's role).

actions.label: Link identity
actions.description: Attach an external identity to a friend.
actions.agent: Link an external identity to a friend, merging any orphan record that already holds it (cross-channel unification).

provider.label: Provider
provider.description: identity provider, e.g. aad, local, teams-conversation, imessage-handle, email-address, a2a-agent

externalId.label: External id
externalId.description: the external identity within the provider

actions.label: Unlink identity
actions.description: Remove an external identity from a friend.
actions.agent: Remove an external identity from a friend.

provider.label: Provider
provider.description: identity provider, e.g. aad, local, teams-conversation, imessage-handle, email-address, a2a-agent

externalId.label: External id
externalId.description: the external identity within the provider

actions.label: Onboard agent
actions.description: Record another agent you can reach, from its coordinates.
actions.agent: Upsert an agent-peer friend record from already-resolved coordinates (no HTTP card fetch).

mailbox.label: Mailbox
mailbox.description: optional A2A git-mailbox coords { repo, selfOutboxAgentId }

actions.label: Connect to
actions.description: Link one of your own agents into this agent's fleet.
actions.agent: Management-sense control plane (brick 8): the owner links one of their OWN agents into this agent's fleet — introduce a peer by agentId/did/name at a trust level (default family for own-fleet). Authority-gated: commits inline ONLY from a local (owner-only stdio) or roster-verified same-account closed sense; an open sense never commits inline (it downgrades to a confirm-prompt); a bare name with no resolvable handle/DID and no record hit returns needs_handle_or_introduction (never fabricates a target). Writes one control-plane audit record (action:'connect') through the wired sink. Returns { ok:true, status:'connected', record } or { ok:false, status:'downgraded'|'needs_handle_or_introduction', downgrade? }.

agentId.label: Agent id
agentId.description: the peer agent's join-key agentId (an owner-supplied handle)

did.label: DID
did.description: the peer's DID (an alternative handle; must resolve to an existing record)

name.label: Name
name.description: the peer's colloquial name (resolves ONLY by matching an existing record — never fabricated)

trustLevel.label: Trust level
trustLevel.description: the trust to link at (default family for own-fleet linked agents)

proof.label: Proof
proof.description: optional opaque proof slot (reserved; the TOFU path ignores it)

actions.label: Who am I
actions.description: Find out who the machine owner is.
actions.agent: Resolve who the machine owner is and which friend record represents the self.

actions.label: Channel capabilities
actions.description: Look up what a channel can carry.
actions.agent: Return the capabilities of a channel (integrations, markdown, streaming, rich cards, max length).

actions.label: Resolve room
actions.description: List who is in a group and how each is known.
actions.agent: Resolve a room (a group's external id) into its members, each with their trust context and how they're known (direct/group_only). Pure read.

channel.label: Channel
channel.description: channel lens for the trust explanation (default mcp)

actions.label: Share profile
actions.description: Prepare a profile to send to another agent, within your consent.
actions.agent: Producer: prepare a consent-gated, scope-filtered, provenance-preserving profile-share envelope for another agent (names the party by join key, never the local uuid). Self identity comes from whoami. Returns { ok, envelope } or { ok:false, status }.

friendId.label: Friend
friendId.description: the local friend to share (uuid or name)

scope.label: Scope
scope.description: what to share: identity scopes carry only the join key; notes:* / outcomes require an explicit grant under the default tiered policy

proof.label: Proof
proof.description: optional opaque proof to stamp on the envelope (for a non-TOFU recipient verifier)

actions.label: Import profile
actions.description: Take in a profile another agent shared, without overwriting your own notes.
actions.agent: Consumer (non-clobbering merge): import a profile-share envelope. Resolves the party by join key; lands facts in the imported namespace WITHOUT touching first-party notes; source trust caps acceptance; never changes the party's trust. Returns { ok, status, record }.

fromAgentId.label: From agent
fromAgentId.description: the agent the envelope arrived from (join-key agentId)

trustOfSource.label: Trust of source
trustOfSource.description: this agent's resolved trust in the source agent — the acceptance cap

actions.label: Grant share
actions.description: Let another agent receive a scope of your data, revocably.
actions.agent: Mint an explicit, revocable consent grant: an agent may receive a scope of a subject (a friend's profile, keyed by friend uuid; or a mission, keyed by its missionKey). The consent half of the moat.

subjectKey.label: Subject
subjectKey.description: whose data may be shared — a local friend uuid for a profile, or a missionKey for a mission (the legacy arg name subjectFriendId is still accepted)

recipientAgentId.label: Recipient
recipientAgentId.description: the agent that may receive it (join-key agentId)

expiresAt.label: Expires
expiresAt.description: optional ISO expiry; absent ⇒ never expires

actions.label: Revoke share
actions.description: Withdraw a consent grant. The audit trail is kept.
actions.agent: Revoke a consent grant by id (tombstones it; the audit trail survives). The right-to-be-forgotten lever.

actions.label: List shares
actions.description: List the consent grants and whether each still holds.
actions.agent: List consent grants with their effective state, optionally filtered by subject / recipient / effectiveness. The audit + revoke surface.

subjectKey.label: Subject
subjectKey.description: filter to one subject — a friend uuid or a missionKey (the legacy arg name subjectFriendId is still accepted)

effectiveOnly.label: Effective only
effectiveOnly.description: set to 'true' to return only grants that currently consent

actions.label: Record mission
actions.description: Create or update a shared mission by its cross-agent key.
actions.agent: Upsert a shared mission (brick 3) by its cross-agent missionKey: create one when the key is unknown, else merge into the existing record. Appends first-party learnings / participants / outcomes and sets status. The mission analogue of record_interaction's outcome writer.

missionKey.label: Mission key
missionKey.description: the cross-agent join key for the mission (a ticket id / repo+PR / slugged name)

title.label: Title
title.description: human title; used only when CREATING (ignored on upsert)

participants.label: Participants
participants.description: agent attributions [{ agentId?, agentName? }], merged deduped by agentId

learnings.label: Learnings
learnings.description: first-party learnings [{ key, value, shareable? }] appended to the mission

outcomes.label: Outcomes
outcomes.description: first-party outcomes [{ missionId, result, note? }] appended to the mission

actions.label: Get mission
actions.description: Look up one mission record.
actions.agent: Fetch a single mission record by its local uuid id.

actions.label: List missions
actions.description: List the mission records.
actions.agent: List mission records, optionally limited.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: max number of records to return

actions.label: Share mission
actions.description: Prepare a mission to send to another agent, within your consent.
actions.agent: Producer: prepare a consent-gated, scope-filtered, provenance-preserving mission-share envelope for another agent (names the mission by its missionKey, never the local uuid). Self identity comes from whoami. 'mission' carries the shareable learnings; 'outcomes' carries the mission's outcomes. Returns { ok, envelope } or { ok:false, status }.

missionId.label: Mission
missionId.description: the local mission to share (its local uuid id)

scope.label: Scope
scope.description: what to share: 'mission' (title/status + shareable learnings) or 'outcomes' (the result rows); both require an explicit grant under the tiered policy

proof.label: Proof
proof.description: optional opaque proof to stamp on the envelope (for a non-TOFU recipient verifier)

actions.label: Import mission
actions.description: Take in a mission another agent shared, without changing your own record.
actions.agent: Consumer (non-clobbering merge): import a mission-share envelope. Resolves the mission by missionKey; lands learnings in the imported namespace WITHOUT touching first-party learnings; append-merges + dedupes outcomes; source trust caps acceptance; never recomputes status/participants. Returns { ok, status, record }.

fromAgentId.label: From agent
fromAgentId.description: the agent the envelope arrived from (join-key agentId)

trustOfSource.label: Trust of source
trustOfSource.description: this agent's resolved trust in the source agent — the acceptance cap

actions.label: Coordinate
actions.description: Offer, accept, decline or hand off a mission to another agent.
actions.agent: Producer (brick 5): prepare a coordination message that negotiates WHO does a mission — one of request/offer/accept/decline/handoff, named by the mission's missionKey (never the local uuid). Consent-gated via the identity-tier 'coordinate' scope (trust ≥ friend suffices). 'accept' claims the assignment for self; 'handoff' (you must hold the assignment) proposes a new assignee whose own accept confirms it (non-transitive). Self identity comes from whoami. Returns { ok, envelope } or { ok:false, status: not_found|no_consent|not_assignee }.

missionId.label: Mission
missionId.description: the local mission to coordinate (its local uuid id)

intent.label: Intent
intent.description: the coordination verb: request (will you take this?) / offer (I'll take this) / accept (yes, I'm on it — sets assignee=self) / decline (no) / handoff (it's yours now — you must hold the assignment; proposes a new assignee)

note.label: Note
note.description: optional free text carried on the message + logged

proposedAssignee.label: Proposed assignee
proposedAssignee.description: the proposed new assignee { agentId?, agentName? } — meaningful ONLY on intent=handoff

task.label: Task
task.description: optional delegation task-spec { summary, details?, inputs? } — meaningful ONLY on intent=request (gap-2); the producer mints a requestId, stamps it on the envelope, and records the delegation first-party for the result-return to correlate against

proof.label: Proof
proof.description: optional opaque proof to stamp on the envelope (for a non-TOFU recipient verifier)

actions.label: Import coordination
actions.description: Take in a coordination message from another agent.
actions.agent: Consumer (brick 5, non-clobbering merge): import a coordination message. Resolves the mission by missionKey; appends the intent to coordination.log stamped origin:imported WITHOUT touching first-party learnings/notes/status; only an 'accept' sets the assignee (last-writer-wins by issuedAt); a 'handoff' never forces an assignee onto you (only your own accept does); never recomputes status/trust/standing; source trust caps acceptance; a friend/family peer may seed an unknown mission. Returns { ok, status: logged|assigned|seeded, record } or { ok:false, status }.

fromAgentId.label: From agent
fromAgentId.description: the agent the envelope arrived from (join-key agentId)

trustOfSource.label: Trust of source
trustOfSource.description: this agent's resolved trust in the source agent — the acceptance cap

actions.label: Get coordination
actions.description: See who holds a mission and its coordination log.
actions.agent: Read lens (brick 5): return a mission's coordination state — its current assignee (who holds it; absent ⇒ unclaimed) + the append-only log of every request/offer/accept/decline/handoff that flowed. Returns { assignee, assignedAt?, log } (the empty default { assignee: undefined, log: [] } when never coordinated), or { ok:false, status:'not_found' } when the mission is missing.

actions.label: Send result
actions.description: Return your finished work for a mission to the agent that delegated it.
actions.agent: Producer (gap-2 — the result-return): B returns its DELIVERABLE for a delegation, attributed to B (from whoami) + correlated to A's task-spec by requestId, named by the mission's missionKey (never the local uuid). Consent-gated via the identity-tier 'coordinate' scope (a result is B answering A's own delegation — trust ≥ friend suffices; NO new scope). Records the result first-party on B's own mission. Returns { ok, envelope } or { ok:false, status: not_found|no_consent }.

missionId.label: Mission
missionId.description: the local mission B is returning a result for (its local uuid id)

toAgentId.label: To agent
toAgentId.description: the recipient agent's join-key agentId — A, the delegator

requestId.label: Request
requestId.description: the delegation correlation key (the task-spec's requestId)

proof.label: Proof
proof.description: optional opaque proof to stamp on the envelope (for a non-TOFU recipient verifier)

actions.label: Import result
actions.description: Take in a result another agent returned for work you delegated.
actions.agent: Consumer (gap-2, non-clobbering merge): A imports B's result-return. Resolves the mission by missionKey; lands B's deliverable QUARANTINED + attributed under importedResults WITHOUT touching first-party; source trust caps acceptance (checked before correlation); a result whose requestId matches no prior first-party delegation is REJECTED (no_delegation — A only accepts results for work it delegated); an unknown mission is no_mission (a result never seeds a mission); never recomputes status/participants. Returns { ok, status, record } or { ok:false, status: untrusted_source|no_mission|no_delegation|invalid }.

fromAgentId.label: From agent
fromAgentId.description: the agent the envelope arrived from (join-key agentId) — B

trustOfSource.label: Trust of source
trustOfSource.description: this agent's resolved trust in the source agent — the acceptance cap
